name: terminal-title
description: Claude Code plugin: names the terminal title after the session and marks working, waiting, and permission states

strip.title: Strip pattern
strip.description: A JavaScript regular expression source. Its first match is removed from the session name in the terminal title only; the session's own name is not changed. Empty (the default) strips nothing.

marker.title: Waiting marker
marker.description: The symbol prepended when the session is waiting for you. One space is added after it; set it to an empty string to disable the marker.

spinner.title: Spinner frames
spinner.description: Frames of the working animation, one entry per frame. One space is added after each frame. An empty list turns the animation off.
